aim: One forecast the reader can check in three days. Did 18K close above tonight's price, and did it stay above the floor? 18K is the Iranian 18-karat gold price per gram, in million toman.
text: 18K, next 3 days vs tonight's 25.32M: 58% to close higher; 90% to stay above 24.60M (−2.8%).

aim: Show what the gold funds' individual investors did so far this trading week (Saturday to Wednesday), and say plainly that one session is too few to conclude anything. The last sentence names what last week showed, without a forecast.
text:
GOLD FUNDS · this week so far, Sat 16 Aban (1 session; Sunday's not read yet)
Money: individuals took out 317B toman; a usual first session brings 420B in
Buyers: 70,191 a day, as usual
Per head: sellers 245M toman, buyers 95M
Too early to call this week. Last week (9–13 Aban), big holders were selling.
